title: Best-of-$N$ Test-Time Steering Can Lead to Reward Hacking in Vision-Language-Action Models
title_zh: Best-of-$N$ 测试时引导可能导致视觉-语言-动作模型中的奖励黑客行为
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promise for general-purpose robotic manipulation, but adapting to changing environmental conditions still remains challenging. Recent test-time steering methods have shown promise in enabling adaptive VLA policies by utilizing additional computation during deployment. In this paper, we consider best-of-$N$ test-time steering for VLA models, where multiple action candidates are sampled from a fixed policy and a verifier is used to select the best one during deployment. We show that increasing $N$ does not always improve performance when the verifier is inaccurate, and can favor candidates whose scores exploit prediction errors, a form of reward hacking. We study this effect on 60 LIBERO-Safety task-level cases using a $π_{0.5}$ policy, with ten repetitions per case. We introduce controlled errors in a MuJoCo trajectory verifier and show that as $N$ increases, selected candidate rewards diverge from the accurate verifier rewards, leading to reward hacking. We also show that verifier calibration and softmax-based candidate selection can mitigate reward hacking in some settings.
abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用机器人操作中展现出潜力，但适应不断变化的环境条件仍然具有挑战性。最近的测试时引导方法通过在部署期间利用额外计算，在实现自适应 VLA 策略方面显示出前景。在本文中，我们考虑 VLA 模型的 best-of-$N$ 测试时引导，即从固定策略中采样多个动作候选，并在部署期间使用验证器选择最佳动作。我们表明，当验证器不准确时，增加 $N$ 并不总能提高性能，并且可能偏向那些分数利用预测错误的候选，这是一种奖励黑客形式。我们使用 $π_{0.5}$ 策略在 60 个 LIBERO-Safety 任务级案例上研究了这种效应，每个案例重复十次。我们在 MuJoCo 轨迹验证器中引入受控错误，并表明随着 $N$ 增加，选中的候选奖励偏离准确的验证器奖励，导致奖励黑客。我们还表明，验证器校准和基于 softmax 的候选选择可以在某些设置下缓解奖励黑客。
tldr_zh: 增加候选数量可能因验证器不准确而引发奖励黑客。
cover_zh: 采样越多反而越差？VLA 测试时引导竟会奖励黑客！
